description: A node_retire that vetoes an artifact in the network: the Spawner stamps the veto mark and archives every node of the network that runs it (architecture §3.13.8). The common fields are in data.schema.json.

artifact_ref.description: The digest of the entry's image, which names the entry (implementation §1.2.11).

operator_proof.description: The operator's proof of the act, with act node_retire (implementation §9.2).
